conviction.explanation: Medium evidence confidence. Revenue evidence defeats an absent-demand argument, while both sides concede unknown normalised earnings, capacity returns and funding. Neither establishes present buying value or observed business impairment. Capacity expansion remains an investment hypothesis rather than a delivered return. Conviction describes the current evidence, not a calibrated win rate; outcome memory has no observations.

executive_summary:
Frontken has genuine operating demand: H1 revenue rose 30% and Taiwan revenue 18% in local currency. Other operating income rose materially, so the 40% H1 profit gain is not an independently established recurring-service growth rate. The approximately RM118m capacity commitment still requires funded utilisation and cash returns. Maintain observation; the evidence does not yet establish a directional new-position advantage.

Price has reclaimed both major averages with positive MACD momentum and above-average volume. The close slightly exceeds the upper band near observed resistance, so the bullish setup still needs follow-through rather than extrapolation of the recent rebound. Frontken has a positive inferred macro demand backdrop from the verified technology expansion. The signal does not assume a specific fab project, margin uplift or FX gain. Revenue evidence defeats an absent-demand argument, while both sides concede unknown normalised earnings, capacity returns and funding. Neither establishes present buying value or observed business impairment. Capacity expansion remains an investment hypothesis rather than a delivered return.
bull_case: Frontken has verified group and Taiwan local-currency revenue expansion. The second bull distinguishes genuine demand from other-income contributions and defends conditional capacity upside, without treating the RM118m commitment as realised earnings. Strongest disconfirming evidence to caution: Group H1 revenue grew 30% and Taiwan revenue grew 18% in TWD; independent demand growth plus constructive technical participation could support profitable expansion.
bear_case: Growth in other income leaves normalised earnings magnitude unquantified, while translated growth trails local activity. Round two accepts demand resilience but identifies unknown funding, utilisation and cash returns as unanswered purchase hurdles at the snapshot premium.
key_uncertainties: Current debt, FCF and funding/utilisation of approximately RM118m capacity commitment.
Matched intrinsic valuation and verified quarterly-report publication date.
Normalised recurring profit excluding other income.
Debt, FCF, funding and utilisation of new Taiwan capacity.
Sustainable translated earnings and matched valuation; report publication date was not retrieved.
Vendor financial statements lack verified fiscal/availability timing; vendor forward P/E is an estimate, and a matched normalised fair-value model is unavailable.
catalysts_upcoming: Next comparable issuer disclosure, date unavailable here: A subsequent comparable disclosure shows positive recurring-profit growth after excluding other-income effects and CFO less maintenance/capacity investment above zero, together with funded utilisation of purchased capacity, resolving the central buy gates.
Reassessment trigger rather than a forecast: Taiwan local-currency revenue growth at or below zero in a subsequent comparable period would invalidate the retained demand-resilience claim.
